notes: Composite Red Bull on the back banner is noticeably dimmer than the surrounding baked-in ads in the original KIA frames. Brightness is the dominant tell — the composite reads as a darkened patch sitting in front of a lit banner row. Letterforms and bull silhouette are crisp; no obvious halo or letter-edge reflex on the back row at this scale. Geometry tracks the banner plane convincingly across motion strips. The pasted-on impression comes from luminance/saturation, not from edge artifacts.
